name: step_response
description: Setpoint steps from 0 to 3 while measurement stays at 0, below the point where output saturates (Kp*error = 2*3 = 6 < limMax = 10). Shows the proportional kick at t=0.2 plus the integral term ramping on top of it. Read from PID.c: out = Kp*error + integrator + differentiator, clamped to [limMin, limMax].

checks.description: Chosen small enough that output never hits limMax; verified max is ~7.19.
